title: Use the powerful working brain to audit Susi capability gaps
goal: Wire the strongest eligible working cloud brain into a production gap-audit workflow covering user intent failures, test/benchmark receipts, code behavior, user feedback and roadmap mastery targets. Compare promised behavior with observed behavior, including gaps hidden behind closed tasks or helper-only tests. Each gap records source receipts, reproducible trigger, expected versus actual behavior, impact, confidence and observation time. Distinguish verified gaps from hypotheses; model claims alone are not evidence. Respect redacted context, privacy, budget and current availability; fall back to another working brain when necessary. Hermetic production-path tests use fake inference and real fixture receipts. Implement nonzero tests named brain_gap_audit_* exercising production wiring.
